newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast products mixed amid rising activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast products mixed amid rising activity.

text.p: U.S. West Coast bulk product prices were mixed midday Thursday as traders began to trade more actively after staying sidelined during yesterday's volatile futures session, brokers said.
"There seems to be more trading interest today. Yesterday's NYMEX action took everyone out of the market," said a broker.
Crude oil for February delivery traded late at $25.45 a barrel, down 50 cents from Wednesday.
And the front-month gasoline contract was seen down about 0.35 cent a gallon at 68.50 cents.
With demand low out west and futures weaker, conventional grade gasoline in Los Angeles eased 0.50 cents a gallon to 74/75 cents a gallon.
CARB grade meanwhile, was flat from yesterday at 75.50/76.50 a barrel.
San Francisco gasolines fell 0.50 to 1.50 cents a gallon.
